create_textbox_condition_class: create a Condition subclass with TEXT_BOX and FEEDBACK constants for trial types
build_textbox_stimulus: build a stimulus that displays a text box with an instruction and 5 second duration
create_feedback_stimulus: create a feedback stimulus that shows RIGHT in green or WRONG in red based on trial results
run_get_trials_generator: run the get_trials generator to yield text box trials followed by feedback trials three times
review_get_feedback_stimulus: review the _get_feedback_stimulus function that checks previous trial results and returns a colored label widget
